title: A nurture email that fails to queue is retried instead of stalling that person's series for good

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (project thread: Check every email and message system)

detail:
With LIFECYCLE_CAP_ENABLED on in production (since 2026-11-17), the nurture runner writes a lifecycle_send_log reservation before it enqueues the step. If the enqueue threw, the reservation stayed; every later run got 'duplicate' from reserveLifecycleSend and hit `continue` without moving the cursor, so the enrollment was re-picked every run and never sent that step or any after it (the /subscribe casual-browser series rides this runner). Fix: a failed enqueue deletes its reservation and defers 15 minutes; a 'duplicate' means the step already went out, so the cursor moves on without a second send.

DONE 2026-11-18: lib/nurture/runner.ts advance() + release on enqueue failure; two runner tests.

verify.note: Passes while a failed enqueue releases the reservation and a duplicate advances the enrollment.
